messages:
wes: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem for the autoscale spike impacting Dedicated in us-west. Capturing owners and short timelines here.

wes: Summary: quota exhaustion + scheduler preemption jitter led to headroom drop to ~6% for ~25m, retries spiked. Full timeline and logs in PM doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/3316-autoscale-spike

anya: ack. good summary. main remediation ideas?

wes: shortlist: 1) request reserved GPUs from cloud (+25 GPUs) 2) scheduler tuning: increase preemption window, soften eviction scoring 3) headroom guardrail per-zone at 10% with alerting 4) synthetic burst tests after changes.

jen: i'll own headroom policy + dashboard. I'll create alert: headroom <12% for 5m -> page on-call, and add recurrence tracking to dashboard. ETA: PR + cards by tomorrow AM.

raman: scheduler tuning is mine. Plan: dev validation today, canary 10% us-west tomorrow. Change: preemption window -> 30s, reduce eviction weight by 0.2. Monitor eviction rate, P95 latency, restart counts. Rollback if >5% error delta. ETA PR EOD today.

liz: filing quota request with cloud now. Ticket CLOUD-5601. Asked for expedited review and linked PM doc + this thread. ETA 48h for approval unless cloud flags urgent. @cloud-ops FYI.

cloud-ops: got the ping, looking into options for reserved capacity and temporary burst credits. Will update CLOUD-5601 by EOD.

anya: i'll prepare synthetic load script and run post-canary. Script below.

```bash
# synthetic burst test: 10x normal traffic against us-west Dedicated pool
python infra/loadtest.py --region us-west --pool dedicated --concurrency 600 --duration 600
```

wes: good. also let's track recurrence: jen, can you add a sheet column "recurrence (yes/no)" and link previous incident IDs? I noticed similar patterns ~3-week cadence.

jen: yes. adding columns: action, owner, due, status, PR/ticket, prior_incidents, recurring_pattern. Will post sheet here when ready.

raman: after canary I'll upload scheduler traces to the PM doc and mark the PR link. ETA: 24h after canary start.

liz: CLOUD-5601 updated: cloud contact requested sizing justification. I attached load patterns and cost estimate. Marking due for follow-up on 2026-03-28.

sre-bot: Note: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Incident INC-2032 created and linked.

wes: timeline recap: liz files quota request (today), raman posts PR + canary (tomorrow), jen creates dashboard/alerts before canary, anya runs synthetic test after canary, wes owns tracking and weekly check-ins.

anya: will also run an aggregated anomaly check across last 3 months to help with recurrence hypothesis. I'll share results in PM doc.

jen: once alerts are live, i'll add runbook steps for on-call to follow when headroom alert fires.

wes: please update the sheet as you make progress. Close the thread with a short note when your item is done and link PR/ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
